speak.title: Role-play: finding time for a friend
speak.setup: Work in pairs. Read your card, then have the conversation. Swap roles and do it again.

a.text: You work long hours and you're tired at the weekend. You'd like to stay friends, but you don't want a big plan. Suggest a short coffee or a video call. Say what you can and cannot do.

b.text: You haven't seen your friend for three months. Messages are not enough for you. Ask to meet face to face, for a walk or a meal. Try to agree a date before you finish.

phrases: How about we meet on Saturday?
I'd love to, but I'm busy that day.
Let's make a plan before we say goodbye.
I don't want us to drift apart.
speak.after: Afterwards, tell the class: what plan did you agree, and was it fair to both of you?
